name: swiss-ball-dumbbell-press.html
instructions:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells and sit on the center of an exercise ball with your feet around shoulder width apart.
2. Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height on each side, and rotate your palms so they are facing forward. This is the starting position for the exercise.
3. Take a deep breath then press the dumbbells overhead by extending the elbows and contracting the deltoids.
4. Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position (the arms should be roughly 90 degrees or slightly lower depending on limb lengths).
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
